A '''songsteel sword''' was a type of [[Sword/Legends|sword]] that was made from [[Songsteel/Legends|songsteel]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] possessed a songsteel sword and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he wielded it in a practice duel in the [[Almas Academy]], against the Jedi Masters [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Devan For'deschel]].
